recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，骨小樑之間的骨髓腔幾乎 100% 被深藍色、均一的小淋巴球瀰漫性佔滿，脂肪幾乎消失，只剩少數散在的巨核細胞；這種瀰漫浸潤模式符合 CLL 的骨髓侵犯（預後較差的模式）。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) between bony trabeculae
Diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of small dark lymphoid cells effacing the marrow
Scattered residual megakaryocytes and few red cell-rich areas
No discrete nodular or paratrabecular pattern identified at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity, with diffuse effacement of the intertrabecular spaces by a monotonous infiltrate of small dark lymphoid cells. Fat is nearly absent, and only scattered residual megakaryocytes are identified. No nodular or paratrabecular pattern is evident. Findings are consistent with diffuse bone marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; the diffuse pattern is associated with more advanced disease.

ddx.vs: MCL can show a similar diffuse or nodular marrow infiltrate, so cyclin D1/SOX11 and CD23 are required.
FL typically infiltrates the marrow in a paratrabecular pattern with CD10-positive centrocytes.
Acute leukemia also packs the marrow, but at higher power shows blasts with fine chromatin and CD34/TdT expression.
